author: CNN
description:
President Donald Trump on Thursday called for former Apple CEO Tim Cook to take the helm at Nvidia, while lauding Jensen Huang as “fantastic” and “a legend.” 

The post represented Trump’s first public comment on Huang’s resignation, which came amid an investigation into his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. 

Trump had been briefed earlier this year on the relationship, which raised national security concerns within the intelligence community. But he opted not to take any action, and Huang remained an influential voice in shaping Trump’s approach to his hands-off regulatory approach to the artificial intelligence industry. 

CNN's Dana Bash discusses the scandal with White House correspondent Alayna Treene and the Inside Politics panel of analysts. Also, CNN's Pamela Brown gets reaction from Rep. Seth Moulton (D-MA).

author: CNN
description:
Democrat Scott Colom scored a major upset in Mississippi, narrowly defeating Republican incumbent Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith. The victory makes Colom the first Democratic senator elected from Mississippi in 44 years and the first Black person elected statewide since Reconstruction. Scott’s identical twin brother, Andrew Colom, joins CNN for an exclusive interview, reacting to the emotional moment the race was called and explaining what his brother’s historic victory means for Mississippi and the country.

Also, the panel analyzes how Colom managed to flip a deep-red seat, from his focus on kitchen-table concerns like grocery and diesel costs to his outreach to Black and rural voters. They also examine what the victory could mean for Democratic strategy across the South and the balance of power in the Senate.
